content: “Ttarem anẓar zi SIDI, di řweqt n wenẓar n tefsut. SIDI ittegg assamen, wah, Netta ad asen iwc ibuda n wenẓar, i kuř ijj n wefsu deg iyyar.

Maɣar řexyařat n l’aṣnam ssawařen řɣecc, u igezzanen ttwařan ixarriqen u nitni ttɛawaden tirja icemmten, nitni ssfewwajen s řeɛwin. X uya i ttwassiggʷejen am wuǧi, ttwaḥṣaren, minzi ameksaw war din iǧi.”
“X imeksawen yarɣa weɣḍab inu u Necc ad xeǧṣeɣ iɣayḍen, maɣar SIDI n řɛeskarat ad issijj x tḥimart nnes, x taddart n Yahuda, u Netta ad ten isedd am uyis nnes ittissiqen ɣar umenɣi.
Zzayes aẓru n teɣmart, zzayes řewted, zzayes řqews n umenɣi, ad zzayes dd-ffɣen xenni marra imzeyyaren jmiɛ.
Nitni marra ad dewřen am ayt n bu-teɣruḍt inni deg umenɣi ad ɛefsen x ubeǧaɛ di zznaqi. Wah, nitni ad mmenɣen, maɣar SIDI ad yiři akidsen, u nitni ad seḍḥan inni inyin x yeysan.

Necc ad ssjehdeɣ taddart n Yahuda u ad ssnejmeɣ taddart n Yusuf u Necc ad asen wceɣ tazeddiɣt, maɣar Necc arreḥmeɣ daysen u nitni ad iřin axmi Necc war ten nḍareɣ, maɣar Necc d SIDI, AREBBI nsen, u Necc ad ɣarsen sřeɣ.”
“Inni n Ifrayim ad iřin am yijj n bu-teɣruḍt u uř nsen ad ifarḥ am ɣar binu, u iḥenjiren nsen ad t ẓaren u ad farḥen, uř nsen ad ifarḥ di SIDI.
Necc ad xasen ṣeffareɣ u ad ten ssmuneɣ, maɣar Necc fdiɣ ten, u nitni ad dd-dewřen deg waṭṭas, am mammec ten tuɣa deg waṭṭas.
Necc ad ten zarɛeɣ jar řegnus u nitni ad ayi idaren di jjwayeh iggʷejjen. Xenni ad ddaren ak-d iḥenjiren nsen uca ad dd-dewřen.
Necc ad ten jjeɣ ad dd-ɛeqben zi Misřa, ad ten dd-ssmuneɣ zi Accur u ad ten dd-awyeɣ ɣar temmurt n Jilɛad u ɣar Lubnan, maca aya war ten ittqeddi.
Netta ad iẓwa řebḥar n řeḥṣaret nsen u ad iwwet řemwaj n řebḥar u marra imucan yuǧɣen n iɣzar n Nil ad aẓɣen. Nnfaxet n Accur ad tᵉttwasswaḍeɛ, u azeǧaḍ n Misřa ad ittwaweddar.
Necc ad ten ssjehdeɣ di SIDI u nitni ad uyuren deg Yisem nnes!”, ammu i iqqar SIDI.

footnotes.text: anẓar n tafsut- anẓar n tefsut di Ccarq Ameřwasu iccat qbeř řweqt n tmeyra deg uyur n mars d wavril.
